objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, instructions and related document versions/properties.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of the document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate and structure documents.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained for relevant companies.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained for areas of validity.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number_per_type
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number for each type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title component of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and maintained for document versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and indicates workflow or lifecycle state.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader user groups and reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for checking the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for releasing the document, including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute for distribution by e-mail notification.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute for distribution requiring active acknowledgement.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Original language version relevant for translation.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type documenting regulations and instructions, especially locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons within a guideline framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed special work steps relevant for limited departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system when creating new documents or adding information to a document.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to a pure object cover or document object.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word or PowerPoint.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific descriptive data maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose in document property editing.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to groups or persons for documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user/person participating in roles, authorizations, workflows, distribution or acknowledgements.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users/persons used for authorization, reader groups, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented in DHC VISION to provide users with appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the main document release cycle and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changes to a document managed without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during approval, validity extension, override, reactivation or acknowledgement processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: released_version
objs.description: Released version of a document for which signatures and content may be documented.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate or override a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning user groups or persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Status used in reports listing acknowledgements.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view filled with information based on distribution groups and documents relevant to users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation or search available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter available for reports and influencing evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion available for reports and filtering result lists.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard list of documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-dependent version of a released document.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which authorized readers see a released language version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document may be visible.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be linked or to which regulations may relate.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.
